# webtables/panic

> Helper: runtime errors. Writes the message to stderr and exits with status 2.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/panic.pkg)


| function | message |
|---|---|
| `$__pk_panic_index` | `panic: index out of range` |
| `$__pk_panic_len` | `panic: negative length in make` |
| `$__pk_panic_oom` | `panic: out of memory` |

Running out of the 8 MB stack panics with `panic: stack overflow`, where
bintables crashes with a segmentation fault.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm

```

## Support code (once per program)

```nasm
(func $__pk_panic (param $msg i32) (param $len i32)
(i32.store (i32.const 16) (local.get $msg))
(i32.store (i32.const 20) (local.get $len))
(drop (call $__wasi_fd_write (i32.const 2) (i32.const 16) (i32.const 1) (i32.const 24)))
(call $__wasi_proc_exit (i32.const 2)))
(func $__pk_panic_index (call $__pk_panic (i32.const 128) (i32.const 26)))
(func $__pk_panic_len (call $__pk_panic (i32.const 160) (i32.const 31)))
(func $__pk_panic_oom (call $__pk_panic (i32.const 192) (i32.const 21)))
(func $__pk_panic_nullfn (call $__pk_panic (i32.const 288) (i32.const 31)))
```
